title: Chintamani Library v2.8.15 — Download Fix & Live Progress
releaseNotes: DOWNLOAD FIX: Resolved 'stuck on connecting to server' — extended connect timeout to 45s for slow mobile networks, maxRedirects raised to 15 for GitHub CDN redirect chains.
LIVE PROGRESS TICKER: Update dialog now shows elapsed seconds while connecting so you know it's working ('Connecting to download server... 5s').
DOWNLOAD PROGRESS: Progress bar now starts from 3% once bytes flow, never goes backward; speed shown in MB/s.
UNIVERSAL QR PORTAL: All portal flows (registration, payment, complaints, feedback) persist to database and appear in Admin portal.
